name: troshchynskyi-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by Illia Troshchynskyi

plugins.name: harness-audit
plugins.description: Audits a repository and a developer's Claude Code setup and delivers evidence-backed recommendations: instructions, verification commands, documentation, skills, rules, hooks, subagents and MCP.

plugins.name: decision-debate
plugins.description: Works out a solution for a development task from several angles: multi-lens research, 2-3 options, an architect vs critic debate with independently verified findings, and a short report you choose from. Manual invocation only.
